problems.explain: Split it into the rectangle and the half circle. Rectangle: 10 × 12 = 120. The half circle sits on the 10 side, so 10 is its diameter and its radius is 5: half of πr² ≈ ½ × 3.14 × 5 × 5 = 39.25. Together 120 + 39.25 = 159.25, which is 159.3 to 1 decimal place. The half circle sits on the 8 side, so 8 is its diameter and its radius is 4: half of πr² ≈ ½ × 3.14 × 4 × 4 = 25.12. Together 112 + 25.12 = 137.12, which is 137.1 to 1 decimal place. (Using 8 as the radius gives four times the half circle.) So 137.1 cm².

prompt.v: This shape is a rectangle with a half circle on top. What is its area, in square inches? Use 3.14 for π and round to 1 decimal place.
